# inferr

> Tools for Statistical Inference

## Overview

inferr builds upon the statistical tests provided in **stats**, provides
additional and flexible input options and more detailed and structured
test results. As of version 0.3, **inferr** includes a select set of
parametric and non-parametric statistical tests which are listed below:

- One Sample t Test
- Paired Sample t Test
- Independent Sample t Test
- One Sample Proportion Test
- Two Sample Proportion Test
- One Sample Variance Test
- Two Sample Variance Test
- Binomial Test
- ANOVA
- Chi Square Goodness of Fit Test
- Chi Square Independence Test
- Levene’s Test
- Cochran’s Q Test
- McNemar Test
- Runs Test for Randomness

## Installation

`# install inferr from CRAN`` `[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"inferr"``)`` `` ``# the development version from github`` ``# install.packages("devtools")`` ``devtools``::`[`install_github`](https://devtools.r-lib.org/reference/install-deprecated.html)`(``"rsquaredacademy/inferr"``)`

## Usage

#### One Sample t Test

[`ifr_os_t_test`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_os_t_test.md)`(``hsb``, ``write``, mu ``=`` ``50``, type ``=`` ``'all'``)`` ``#> One-Sample Statistics `` ``#> ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> Variable Obs Mean Std. Err. Std. Dev. [95% Conf. Interval] `` ``#> ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> write 200 52.775 0.6702 9.4786 51.4537 54.0969 `` ``#> ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> `` ``#> Two Tail Test `` ``#> --------------- `` ``#> `` ``#> Ho: mean(write) ~=50 `` ``#> Ha: mean(write) !=50 `` ``#> --------------------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> Variable t DF Sig Mean Diff. [95% Conf. Interval] `` ``#> --------------------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> write 4.141 199 0.00005 2.775 1.4537 4.0969 `` ``#> --------------------------------------------------------------------------------`

#### ANOVA

[`ifr_oneway_anova`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_oneway_anova.md)`(``hsb``, ``write``, ``prog``)`` ``#> ANOVA `` ``#> ----------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> Sum of `` ``#> Squares DF Mean Square F Sig. `` ``#> ----------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> Between Groups 3175.698 2 1587.849 21.275 0 `` ``#> Within Groups 14703.177 197 74.635 `` ``#> Total 17878.875 199 `` ``#> ----------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> `` ``#> Report `` ``#> -----------------------------------------`` ``#> Category N Mean Std. Dev. `` ``#> -----------------------------------------`` ``#> 1 45 51.333 9.398 `` ``#> 2 105 56.257 7.943 `` ``#> 3 50 46.760 9.319 `` ``#> -----------------------------------------`` ``#> `` ``#> Number of obs = 200 R-squared = 0.1776 `` ``#> Root MSE = 8.6392 Adj R-squared = 0.1693`

#### Chi Square Test of Independence

[`ifr_chisq_assoc_test`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_chisq_assoc_test.md)`(``hsb``, ``female``, ``schtyp``)`` ``#> Chi Square Statistics `` ``#> `` ``#> Statistics DF Value Prob `` ``#> ----------------------------------------------------`` ``#> Chi-Square 1 0.0470 0.8284`` ``#> Likelihood Ratio Chi-Square 1 0.0471 0.8282`` ``#> Continuity Adj. Chi-Square 1 0.0005 0.9822`` ``#> Mantel-Haenszel Chi-Square 1 0.0468 0.8287`` ``#> Phi Coefficient 0.0153 `` ``#> Contingency Coefficient 0.0153 `` ``#> Cramer's V 0.0153 `` ``#> ----------------------------------------------------`

#### Levene’s Test

[`ifr_levene_test`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_levene_test.md)`(``hsb``, ``read``, group_var ``=`` ``race``)`` ``#> Summary Statistics `` ``#> Levels Frequency Mean Std. Dev `` ``#> -----------------------------------------`` ``#> 1 24 46.67 10.24 `` ``#> 2 11 51.91 7.66 `` ``#> 3 20 46.8 7.12 `` ``#> 4 145 53.92 10.28 `` ``#> -----------------------------------------`` ``#> Total 200 52.23 10.25 `` ``#> -----------------------------------------`` ``#> `` ``#> Test Statistics `` ``#> -------------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> Statistic Num DF Den DF F Pr > F `` ``#> -------------------------------------------------------------------------`` ``#> Brown and Forsythe 3 196 3.44 0.0179 `` ``#> Levene 3 196 3.4792 0.017 `` ``#> Brown and Forsythe (Trimmed Mean) 3 196 3.3936 0.019 `` ``#> -------------------------------------------------------------------------`

#### Cochran’s Q Test

[`ifr_cochran_qtest`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_cochran_qtest.md)`(``exam``, ``exam1``, ``exam2``, ``exam3``)`` ``#> Test Statistics `` ``#> ----------------------`` ``#> N 15 `` ``#> Cochran's Q 4.75 `` ``#> df 2 `` ``#> p value 0.093 `` ``#> ----------------------`

#### McNemar Test

`hb`` ``<-`` ``hsb`` ``hb``$``himath`` ``<-`` `[`ifelse`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/ifelse.html)`(``hsb``$``math`` ``>`` ``60``, ``1``, ``0``)`` ``hb``$``hiread`` ``<-`` `[`ifelse`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/ifelse.html)`(``hsb``$``read`` ``>`` ``60``, ``1``, ``0``)`` `[`ifr_mcnemar_test`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_mcnemar_test.md)`(``hb``, ``himath``, ``hiread``)`` ``#> Controls `` ``#> ---------------------------------`` ``#> Cases 0 1 Total `` ``#> ---------------------------------`` ``#> 0 135 21 156 `` ``#> 1 18 26 44 `` ``#> ---------------------------------`` ``#> Total 153 47 200 `` ``#> ---------------------------------`` ``#> `` ``#> McNemar's Test `` ``#> ----------------------------`` ``#> McNemar's chi2 0.2308 `` ``#> DF 1 `` ``#> Pr > chi2 0.631 `` ``#> Exact Pr >= chi2 0.7493 `` ``#> ----------------------------`` ``#> `` ``#> Kappa Coefficient `` ``#> --------------------------------`` ``#> Kappa 0.4454 `` ``#> ASE 0.075 `` ``#> 95% Lower Conf Limit 0.2984 `` ``#> 95% Upper Conf Limit 0.5923 `` ``#> --------------------------------`` ``#> `` ``#> Proportion With Factor `` ``#> ----------------------`` ``#> cases 0.78 `` ``#> controls 0.765 `` ``#> ratio 1.0196 `` ``#> odds ratio 1.1667 `` ``#> ----------------------`

## Getting Help

If you encounter a bug, please file a minimal reproducible example using
[reprex](https://reprex.tidyverse.org/index.html) on github. For
questions and clarifications, use
[StackOverflow](https://stackoverflow.com/).

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the inferr project is released with a [Contributor Code
of Conduct](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html). By
contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

  : Binomial Test

  : Levene's test for equality of variances

  : One Sample Test of Proportion

  : One Sample t Test
- [`ifr_os_var_test()`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_os_var_test.md)
  : One Sample Variance Comparison Test
- [`ifr_ts_ind_ttest()`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_ts_ind_ttest.md)
  : Two Independent Sample t Test
- [`ifr_ts_paired_ttest()`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_ts_paired_ttest.md)
  : Paired t test
- [`ifr_ts_prop_test()`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_ts_prop_test.md)
  [`ifr_ts_prop_group()`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_ts_prop_test.md)

  : Two Sample Test of Proportion
- [`ifr_ts_var_test()`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/ifr_ts_var_test.md)
  : Two Sample Variance Comparison Test

## Data

inferr comes with a built-in datasets which are used to illustrate the
functions as well as for running tests.

- [`hsb`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/hsb.md) : High
  School and Beyond Data Set
- [`exam`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/exam.md) : Dummy
  data set for Cochran's Q test
- [`treatment`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/treatment.md)
  : Dummy data set for 2 Sample Proportion test
- [`treatment2`](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com/reference/treatment2.md)
  : Dummy data set for 2 Sample Proportion test
